title: One attempt step or state change of an update item
description: Append-only history entry (story 593 writes them). type, from and to must be an edge of upgrade-states.v1.json, with an actor that edge allows and the fields that type requires; record-format.mjs checks both. Reference: .agents/reference/upgrade-records.md.

id.description: 'ev:' plus the first 24 hex digits of sha256 over [item_id, type, at, attempt or null]. eventId() computes it, so a write retried after a failure carries the same id.

type.description: approval-recorded and schedule-set are reserved for piece 2 and refused by the validator.

from.description: The item's state before the event; null when the event is the first one for the item.

recorded_at.description: When it was written, if later than at (a backfill).

recorded_by.description: lane = written by the night lane as it happened; backfill = reconstructed later from GitHub (story 593).

attempt.description: The attempt this event belongs to (1-based). Required by every type except observed and closed.

drill.description: True on every event of a revert drill (story 753).

class.description: Machine-readable cause: the lane class for observed, the refusal for merge-refused, the failure mode for verification-failed.

checks.description: What the verifier checked, one 'name: result' line each.

merge_call.description: The merge call as the merge step recorded it, with its exit status (story 752).

pr_refusals.description: The merge step's refusals about the PR, as written.

lane_refusals.description: The merge step's refusals about the lane itself, as written.
